DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。どのようなことをお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 施設の使い方について意見を書きました。箱へ入れるだけでは個別の返答があるか分からないので、相談方法を聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 意見投函だけで個別返答があるか不明なので相談方法を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I wrote some feedback about using the facility. I don't know whether simply putting it in the box will get an individual reply, so I would like to ask how to seek advice.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask how to consult someone because you do not know whether submitting feedback alone brings an individual reply. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どの施設についてのご意見ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Which facility is your feedback about?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 地域集会室です。利用時間を変えてほしいという意見と、今の申込方法を知りたいという質問を同じ紙へ書きました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 集会室時間変更希望と現行申込質問を同じ紙に書いたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: The community meeting room. On the same sheet, I wrote both a request to change the hours and a question about the current application process.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you wrote a request to change the meeting room hours and a question about the current application process on the same sheet. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 変更への意見と現行の案内は分けて担当へお伝えできます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: We can pass on your suggested change and your request for current guidance separately to the staff in charge.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: では時間変更の希望は意見として残し、今の申し込み方は窓口で教えてほしいです。変更されるまで予約できないと思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 変更希望は意見で現行申込は窓口に聞きたいと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Then please keep my request to change the hours as feedback, and tell me at the counter how to apply now. I thought I couldn't book until the change was made.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Answer that the requested change should remain feedback, while you want to ask the counter about the current application process. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 現在の申し込みは、現行の案内に沿ってご相談ください。変更の可否は別の確認です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please ask about current applications according to the present guidance. Whether the change can be made is a separate matter to check.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。今使える方法を聞き、意見の採用を前提に日程を決めません。返答の扱いも担当へ確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 現行方法で使い意見採用を前提に予定せず回答扱いを確認すると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Understood. I'll ask about the method available now and won't set my dates assuming my suggestion will be adopted. I'll also check with the staff how replies are handled.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will use the current process, avoid planning on the assumption that your suggestion is adopted, and check how replies work. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 二つの用件として担当へおつなぎします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will connect you to the staff with these as two separate matters.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 時間変更の意見と現行予約の質問を分けます。予約は今の条件で考え、意見への回答方法は別に聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 予約質問と変更意見を分け現行条件と意見回答を別に聞くと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll separate the suggested change of hours from the question about booking now. I'll plan my booking under the present conditions and ask separately how my feedback will be answered.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will separate the booking question from the suggested change, and ask separately about current conditions and feedback replies. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 現行案内と改善意見を区別したご相談で承りました。ありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: We have received your enquiry distinguishing current guidance from suggestions for improvement. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。診察前に何かお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Can I help you with anything before your examination?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 家の階段で困ることを説明したくて写真を撮りました。家族の顔も入っているので、必要な写真だけ見せたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 階段の困り事写真に家族も写るので必要一枚だけ見せたいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I took photos to explain a difficulty with the stairs at home. My family members' faces are in some of them too, so I only want to show the necessary photo.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that because family members also appear in your photos of the stair difficulty, you only want to show the one necessary photo. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 診察でご自身から見せる写真ですね。説明したい場所はどちらですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: These are photos you will show yourself during the examination, correct? Which part do you want to explain?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 玄関から二階へ上がる所です。段の高さを数字で伝えるより、手すりの位置が写った一枚を使いたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 玄関二階の手すり位置の一枚で説明したいと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: The stairs from the entrance up to the second floor. Rather than giving the step heights as numbers, I want to use one photo showing where the handrail is.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Answer that you want to explain using one photo showing the handrail between the entrance and the second floor. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 担当へ写真を使いたいことを伝えられます。受付で全てを預かる必要はありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: We can tell the person in charge you want to use a photo. Reception does not need to take all of them.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 電話の中の写真を全部渡さず、階段の一枚を自分で出します。家族が写る別の写真を続けて開かないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 全画像を渡さず階段写真を自分で出し家族画像へ進まないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I won't hand over all the photos on my phone; I'll open the one stair photo myself. I'll make sure not to continue opening other photos that show my family.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will not hand over all images, will open the stair photo yourself, and will not move on to family photos. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 写真だけで分からない動作は、ご本人から説明してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please explain in your own words any movements that cannot be understood from the photo alone.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 上る時は途中で一度止まることを話します。写真を見れば困る理由まで全て分かるとは思っていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 途中で止まる動作も説明し写真だけで理由全部が分かると思わないと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll explain that I stop once partway up. I don't think looking at the photo will explain every reason I have difficulty.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will also explain stopping partway up, and do not expect a photo alone to explain every reason for the difficulty. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 診察で写真とご説明を合わせてお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: During the examination, present both the photo and your explanation together.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 手すりが写った一枚を選び、止まる場所を自分で示します。ほかの家族の写真は見せず、判断は担当に聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 手すり画像と止まる位置を示し家族写真を見せず担当判断を聞くと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll choose the one photo showing the handrail and point out myself where I stop. I won't show other family photos, and I'll ask the person in charge for their assessment.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm that you will show the handrail image and stopping place, avoid showing family photos, and ask for the staff member's assessment. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 階段の写真で生活場面を説明するご希望ですね。診察でお知らせください。お大事になさってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: You would like to explain an everyday situation with a photo of the stairs. Please mention it during your examination. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。何かお困りですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: かばんを落としました。中身を伝えたいのですが、財布が入っていたか今は自信がありません。確かな物から話してもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 紛失かばんの財布有無は自信なく確実な中身から報告したいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I lost my bag. I want to report its contents, but I'm not sure now whether my wallet was inside. May I start with the things I know for certain?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you are unsure whether your wallet was in the lost bag and want to report the definite contents first. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: はい。最後にかばんを持っていた場所を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Yes. Please tell me the last place you had the bag.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: バスを降りた時は持っていました。その後歩いて家に着いたらありませんでした。道のどこで落としたかは見ていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: バス降車時所持し帰宅時無いが落とした地点未目撃と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: I had it when I got off the bus. After walking home, I noticed it was gone. I didn't see where along the road I dropped it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you had it when getting off the bus and it was missing on arriving home, but you did not see where it fell. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 中身で覚えている物は何でしょうか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 青い水筒と会社の帽子は、乗る前に入れました。財布は朝上着へ入れたかもしれず、かばんの中とは言い切れません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 青水筒会社帽子は確実で財布は上着かもしれないと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I put in a blue water bottle and my company cap before boarding. I may have put my wallet in my jacket that morning, so I cannot say for certain it was in the bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Answer that the blue water bottle and company cap are certain, while the wallet may have been in your jacket. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 分かる物と未確認の物を分けて記録します。ご自宅の上着を確認できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will record the definite and unconfirmed items separately. Can you check your jacket at home?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 帰って確認できます。財布を入れたと断定して届けた後で変えるのでなく、今は確認中とお伝えします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 家で上着を確認し財布入りと断定せず確認中として伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I can go home and check. Rather than reporting the wallet as definitely inside and changing that later, I'll say it is still being checked now.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will check the jacket at home and report the wallet as being checked rather than definitely in the bag. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 確認して分かったことは、追加でお知らせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please let us know anything additional you find out after checking.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: かばんと確実な二点の特徴を伝えます。財布は家で探し、見付かった場合も分からないままの場合も改めて連絡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 確実二点を届け財布を探した結果や未確認継続を追加連絡すると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll describe the bag and the two definite items. I'll look for the wallet at home and contact you again whether I find it or still cannot tell.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will report the two definite items and later report the search result for the wallet or that it remains unconfirmed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 紛失したかばんと確実な中身として承りました。追加の確認をお願いします。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: We have recorded the lost bag and its confirmed contents. Please follow up on the additional checks. Thank you for consulting us.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。荷物の発送で何かお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Can I help you send your parcel?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 箱へ伝票を貼ろうとしたら、ここに開けるための引き手があります。受取人が使えるよう、貼る面を相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 箱引き手を伝票でふさがぬよう貼付面を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: When I was about to attach the shipping label, I noticed this pull tab for opening the box. I'd like advice on which surface to use so the recipient can still use the tab.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask which surface to attach the shipping label to so it does not cover the box's opening tab. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 箱を見せてください。まだ伝票は貼っていませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please show me the box. Have you attached the label yet?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだです。この側面の細い部分が引き手です。見た目が平らなので、そこへ貼りそうになりました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 側面細い引き手は平らで貼りそうになったが未貼付と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Not yet. This narrow strip on the side is the tab. It looks flat, so I almost attached the label there.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that the narrow side tab looks flat and you nearly attached the label there, but have not yet done so. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 引き手と箱の大きさを確認し、伝票を読み取れる貼り方をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will check the tab and the box size and explain how to attach the label so it can be read.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 伝票を細く折って引き手の横へ詰めるのでなく、広い面に貼れるか見ていただきたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 伝票を折って狭所へ貼らず広い面を確認してほしいと求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Instead of folding the label narrowly and squeezing it beside the tab, I'd like you to check whether it can go on a broad surface.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask the staff to check a broad surface rather than fold the label to fit a narrow place. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらの広い面をご利用いただけます。貼る前に宛先の記入も確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: You can use this broad surface. Check the address entries before attaching it too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 住所は書きましたが、箱の開け方のメモは宛先欄へ入れません。必要なら中の紙へ書きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 宛先記入と開封説明を分けメモは中の紙へ入れると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I've written the address, but I won't put instructions for opening the box in the address field. If needed, I'll write them on a sheet inside.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Answer that you will separate the address from opening instructions and put a note on a sheet inside. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 伝票と開封の案内を分けてください。ふたの固定も確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please keep the label and opening instructions separate. We will also check that the lid is secured.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 宛先を見直して広い面に貼り、引き手を残します。開け方の紙は中へ入れ、ふたを閉じた状態を確認して出します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 広い面へ貼り引き手を残し説明紙とふた固定を確認後出すと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll recheck the address, attach it to the broad surface, and leave the tab accessible. I'll put the opening instructions inside and check that the lid is closed before sending it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will attach the label to the broad surface, leave the tab free, and check the instruction sheet and secured lid before sending. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 伝票と開封口を分けて準備しましょう。こちらで箱を確認します。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Let's prepare the label separately from the opening tab. We will check the box here. Thank you for asking.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。何かお手伝いできますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 担当に持参物を出すよう言われましたが、かばんの底へ入れた印鑑が見付かりません。通路で全部出さず、整理できる場所はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: かばん底の印鑑が不明で通路へ全荷物を出さず整理場所を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: The staff told me to take out the items I brought, but I can't find the personal seal I put at the bottom of my bag. Is there somewhere to sort things out without emptying everything in the passage?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for a place to sort your bag because you cannot find the seal at its bottom, without spreading all your belongings in the passage. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらの空いた台をご利用いただけます。手続きの途中でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: You can use this free table. Are you in the middle of a procedure?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい、受付番号を呼ばれた後です。勝手に帰ったと思われないよう、荷物を整理して戻ると担当へ伝えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 呼出し後の手続き中で整理して戻ると担当へ伝えたいと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, after my reception number was called. I'd like to tell the staff I will sort my belongings and return so they don't think I left without saying anything.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that your number has already been called and you are in the middle of a procedure, and want to say you will sort your things and return. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 担当へお伝えします。貴重品を置いたままにせず、ご自身で管理してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll tell the staff. Please manage your valuables yourself and do not leave them unattended.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 財布や書類も一緒に持って台へ移ります。印鑑だけを別の人に取って来てもらうのでなく、自分で探します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 財布書類も自分で持ち台へ移り他人に印鑑を探させないと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll take my wallet and documents with me to the table too. I will look for the seal myself, rather than have someone else go and fetch just the seal.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Answer that you will take your wallet and documents to the table yourself and will not have someone else look for the seal. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 見付かったら、元の窓口へお声がけください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: When you find it, please speak to the original counter.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 印鑑ケースは赤です。ポケットごと順に見て、取り出した物は戻します。似たケースから別の物を出さないよう中も確かめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 赤ケースをポケット順に探し取り出し物を戻して中身も確かめる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: The seal case is red. I'll check each pocket in order and put back anything I take out. I'll also check inside so I don't take out the wrong item from a similar case.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will look for the red case pocket by pocket, put back removed items, and check the contents too. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ご準備ができてから、必要な持ち物を担当が確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Once you are ready, the staff will check the required items.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 赤いケースと中身を確認して戻ります。台に書類を残さず全部しまい、担当へ準備できたと伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: ケース中身確認後全荷物をしまい担当へ準備完了を知らせると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll check the red case and its contents, then return. I'll pack everything away without leaving documents on the table and tell the staff I am ready.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that after checking the case and contents you will put all belongings away and tell the staff you are ready. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 台をお使いください。戻る際にお声がけをお願いします。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please use the table. Let us know when you return. Thank you for asking.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。何かお手伝いできますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 長いねぎを買いたいのですが、手持ちの袋から大きく出ます。売場で勝手に折るのでなく、持ち帰り方を相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 長いねぎを勝手に折らず小袋での持帰り方を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I want to buy long green onions, but they stick far out of my bag. Rather than breaking them in the produce area without permission, I'd like advice on carrying them home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask how to carry long green onions home in a small bag without breaking them without permission. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どのくらいの袋をお持ちですか。歩いてお帰りになりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: How big is your bag? Will you walk home?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この小さな袋です。歩いて帰ります。横に持つと人へ当たりそうなので、できれば立てて持ちたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 小袋徒歩で横持ちは人へ当たるので立てて持ちたいと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: This small one. I'll walk home. If I carry them sideways, they may hit people, so I'd prefer to hold them upright.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you have a small bag and are walking, and want to hold the onions upright because carrying them sideways could hit people. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 長い物を入れる袋が使えるか確認します。売場の商品は、購入前に切ったり折ったりしないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll check whether a bag for long items is available. Please don't cut or break products in the sales area before buying them.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 分かりました。白い部分を折って短くするつもりでしたが、そのまま買い、長さに合う袋を選びます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 白部分を折る考えをやめ未加工購入し長さに合う袋を選ぶと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Understood. I had thought of breaking the white parts to shorten them, but I'll buy them intact and choose a bag that fits their length.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Answer that you will give up breaking the white parts, buy them intact, and choose a bag fitting their length. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらの袋なら上は出ますが、立てて持てます。ほかの商品と一緒に入れますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Their tops will protrude from this bag, but you can hold them upright. Will you put other items in with them?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 卵もあります。ねぎの上へ卵を重ねず、卵は別の袋にします。ねぎの先が人へ向かない持ち方を確かめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 卵を別袋にしねぎ先が人へ向かぬ持ち方を確かめると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I also have eggs. I won't stack the eggs on the onions; I'll put the eggs in another bag. I'll check how to hold the onions so their tips do not point toward people.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will bag the eggs separately and check how to carry the onions without pointing their tips at people. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 袋の口を強く結ぶとねぎが曲がるので、包み方は会計時にもご相談ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Tying the bag's opening tightly will bend the onions, so ask about wrapping at checkout too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ねぎは切らずに会計し、長い袋で立てて持ちます。卵とは分け、袋に収める時に店員さんへ聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 切らず会計後長袋で立て卵を分け収め方を店員に聞くと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll pay for the onions without cutting them and carry them upright in a long bag. I'll separate them from the eggs and ask a staff member how to put them in the bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm that you will pay without cutting them, hold them upright in a long bag, separate the eggs, and ask staff how to pack them. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 購入前に形を変えず、袋を分けてご準備ください。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please keep their shape unchanged before purchase and prepare separate bags. Thank you for asking.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。何かお困りですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 風で画材の箱が開いて、色鉛筆が歩道へ転がりました。通る人へ急に飛び出さず、回収したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 風で歩道へ散った色鉛筆を人へ飛び出さず回収したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: The wind opened my art supply box and colored pencils rolled onto the footpath. I want to pick them up without suddenly darting in front of passersby.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you want to collect colored pencils blown onto the footpath without darting out in front of people. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どの辺りへ転がりましたか。水辺まで飛んだ物はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Where did they roll? Did any go as far as the water?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: このベンチから歩道へ三本です。水の方には見えていませんが、見ていない所まで全部分かるわけではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 見えた三本と水辺未目撃の範囲を区別して説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Three rolled from this bench onto the footpath. I haven't seen any toward the water, but that doesn't mean I know everything about places I haven't looked.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain the distinction between the three pencils you saw and the areas near the water you have not observed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 通行する方に気を付けて、見えている物から回収してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Watch out for people passing, and collect the ones you can see first.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: まず箱を閉めて残りを押さえます。また飛ぶまま一本ずつ追いかけず、歩道が空いてから三本を拾います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 残り箱を閉じ歩道が空いてから三本拾うと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: First I'll close the box and secure the rest. Instead of chasing them one by one while more can blow away, I'll wait until the footpath is clear and pick up the three.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Answer that you will close the box containing the rest and collect the three after the footpath clears. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 紙も一枚ベンチの下にありますね。道具の数は分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: There is also a sheet of paper under the bench. Do you know how many supplies you have?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 色鉛筆は十二本です。拾った後に数えて不足を確認します。ベンチの下の紙も自分の物なので回収します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 総数十二と自分の紙を回収し後で不足確認すると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: There are twelve colored pencils. I'll count after picking them up to check for missing ones. The paper under the bench is also mine, so I'll collect it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that there are twelve in total, you will collect your paper too, and check for missing items afterward. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 不足があっても、植込みへ無理に入らず管理窓口へご相談ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Even if some are missing, don't force your way into the planting area; ask the management counter.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 箱を閉じ、三本と紙を回収して数えます。足りない場合は見た範囲を窓口へ伝え、植込みを踏んで探しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 回収後数え不足なら目撃範囲を窓口へ伝え植込みへ入らないと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll close the box, pick up the three pencils and paper, and count them. If any are missing, I'll tell the counter which area I saw and won't trample the plants to search.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm that you will count after collecting, tell the counter what you observed if items are missing, and not enter the planting area. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 周りの通行を確認して回収してください。お知らせありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08207-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Check passing traffic around you before collecting them. Thank you for letting us know.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。何かお困りですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 雨で片方の靴が濡れて、ひももほどけました。列車が来ていますが、急いで乗る前に座って結び直したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 濡れてひもがほどけた靴を乗車前に座って結び直したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: One of my shoes got wet in the rain and its lace came undone. The train is arriving, but rather than hurry aboard, I'd like to sit and retie it first.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you want to sit and retie the wet shoe's loose lace before boarding. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらのベンチを使えます。次の列車でもご予定に間に合いますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: You can use this bench. Will the next train still get you there in time?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 少し遅れますが、走って靴が脱げるより次にします。待っている人へ到着が遅れると連絡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 少し遅れるが次便を選び相手へ遅れを連絡すると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: I'll be a little late, but I'd rather take the next one than run and have my shoe come off. I'll let the person waiting know that I'll arrive late.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Answer that although you will be a little late, you will choose the next service and tell the person about the delay. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 通路に足を伸ばさず、ベンチで整えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please sort it out on the bench without stretching your legs into the passage.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: かばんを自分の横へ置き、ひもを結びます。濡れた靴をホームに置いて裸足で移動するつもりはありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 通路に足を伸ばさずかばん横で結び裸足移動しないと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll put my bag beside me and tie the lace. I do not intend to leave the wet shoe on the platform and move about barefoot.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will tie the lace with your bag beside you without extending your legs into the passage, and will not move barefoot. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 準備ができたら次の列車の案内をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: When you are ready, check the information for the next train.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい、今の列車と同じ行先か表示を見ます。前の便を見送ったからといって、次が同じとは決めません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 次便が前便と同一行先と決めず表示を見ると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes, I'll look at the display to see whether it has the same destination as the current train. Missing the previous one doesn't mean I'll assume the next is the same.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will check the display rather than assume the next service has the same destination as the previous one. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 発車案内で行先と時刻を確認できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: You can check the destination and time on the departure board.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ひもを結んでから次の便を確かめ、遅れる時刻を相手へ伝えます。かばんも忘れず持って乗ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 靴準備後便確認と遅刻連絡をしてかばん持参で乗ると確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: After tying the lace, I'll check the next service and tell the person my delayed arrival time. I'll remember to take my bag aboard too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm that after fixing the shoe you will check the train, notify the person of your delay, and board with your bag. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ベンチで足元を整えてからお進みください。お気を付けて。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please get your footwear ready on the bench before moving on. Take care. Thank you for asking.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。どのようなご用件でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. What can I do for you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 地域の見学会へ二人で申し込みましたが、同行者が参加できなくなりました。私まで取り消すのでなく、人数だけ変えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 二人見学申込の同行者欠席で本人取消でなく人数のみ変更希望と話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I registered two people for a local visit, but my companion can no longer attend. I want to change just the number of participants, not cancel myself as well.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that your companion cannot attend the visit booked for two, and you want to change only the number, not cancel your own participation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 申し込みの控えと、申込者のお名前は分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you have your application copy and the applicant's name?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この控えです。代表者は私で、二名と書かれています。欠席するのは同行者だけで、私は予定どおり参加します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 代表は本人で二名控えあり本人は予定通り参加と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Here is the copy. I am the lead applicant, and it says two people. Only my companion cannot attend; I will take part as planned.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you are the lead applicant with a copy for two people and will attend as planned. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 人数変更が可能か、担当へ確認します。新しい同行者へ替えるご希望はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll check with the staff whether the number can be changed. Do you want to replace your companion with someone new?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 代わりの人を探して入れる予定はありません。一名にしたいので、名前の変更と人数の変更を混ぜず相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 代替同行者でなく一名への人数変更を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I don't plan to find a replacement. I want to make it one person, so I'll ask without confusing a name change with a change in numbers.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask to change the number to one, not replace the companion. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 確認が取れるまで、新しい申し込みを重ねて出さないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please do not submit another new application until we confirm.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい、最初の二名と追加の一名が両方残らないよう、この控えの変更として問い合わせます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 重複新申込でなく元控えの変更として問い合わせると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I'll ask to amend this application copy so the original two-person application and an additional one-person application do not both remain.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Answer that you will enquire about amending the original application rather than making a duplicate new one. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当から変更の方法と、当日の案内をご説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: The staff will explain how to change it and the instructions for the day.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 代表者本人は参加、同行者のみ欠席と伝えます。変更後の人数を確認して、古い二名の控えにも変更があったとメモします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 本人参加同行者欠席と伝え変更人数確認後旧控えへ変更メモすると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll say the lead applicant will attend and only the companion is absent. I'll confirm the revised number and note the change on the old two-person copy too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will explain your own attendance and your companion's absence, confirm the changed number, and note the change on the old copy. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 人数のみの変更希望として担当へおつなぎします。ご連絡ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll connect you to the staff as a request to change only the number. Thank you for contacting us.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。受付で何かお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Can I help you at reception?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 自分の診察券を家に忘れました。財布に家族のカードがありますが、同じ病院でも代わりに出す物ではないので、本人の受付方法を聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 本人診察券を忘れ家族カードは代用せず受付方法を聞きたいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I left my own patient card at home. There is a family member's card in my wallet, but even at the same hospital it is not a substitute, so I want to ask how to register myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you forgot your patient card and want to ask how to register without substituting a family member's card. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ご本人のお名前などを確認します。以前こちらで受診されましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: We will check your name and other details. Have you visited us before?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい、先月来ました。家族のカードの番号を私の番号として言わず、自分の名前と前回の時期を伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 本人先月受診で家族番号でなく名前前回時期を伝えると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, I came last month. I won't give my family member's card number as mine; I'll give my own name and the time of my previous visit.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Answer that you visited last month and will give your name and previous visit time rather than your family member's number. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 診察券をお持ちでない場合の受付を担当が案内します。今日はご予約がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: The staff will explain registration without a patient card. Do you have an appointment today?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 予約してあります。時刻のメモは電話にあるので、家族のカードではなく、そのメモを出して確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 予約あり本人電話メモで予約時刻を確認したいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. The time is in a note on my phone, so I would like to open that note rather than my family member's card to check it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you have an appointment and want to check its time with the note on your own phone. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 予約と本人の確認を進めます。カードの再発行も希望されていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will confirm your appointment and identity. Do you also want a replacement card?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今回は家にあると思うので、すぐ紛失として再発行するかは決めていません。今日は持参忘れとして相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 家にある見込みで即紛失再発行ではなく持参忘れと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I think it is at home, so I haven't decided to immediately report it as lost and request a replacement. Today I'm asking as someone who forgot to bring it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that you expect it is at home and are asking about forgetting it, rather than immediately treating it as lost and replacing it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 持参忘れと再発行の希望を分けて伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will distinguish forgetting to bring it from a request for a replacement.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 自分の名前と予約時刻を伝え、今日の受付を確認します。家に戻ってカードを探し、本当に無ければその時に改めて相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 今日本人受付後家で探し無いと分かれば改めて相談すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll give my own name and appointment time and check today's registration. I'll look for the card when I get home, and if it really is missing, ask again then.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that after registering yourself today you will look at home, and consult again if you find it is truly missing. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご本人の受付と診察券の持参忘れとして承りました。担当へご案内します。お大事になさってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: We have received this as registration for yourself and a forgotten patient card. I will direct you to the staff. Take care.
